meta.name: topic_routing
meta.title: Email topic routing
meta.description: Route inbound emails to Lumora, a fictional smart-home device and app-subscription company, to the team that must act on the main request.

department.instructions: Which team must act on the main request in `email`?

criteria.billing: charges, invoices, subscription payments, refunds of money already paid
criteria.technical_support: a device or the app not working, setup, connectivity or firmware problems
criteria.sales: buying new products, quotes, bulk or business orders, pricing before purchase
criteria.account_access: logging in, passwords, two-factor codes, locked or hijacked accounts
criteria.shipping: where an order is, delivery delays, damaged or wrong items in a delivery, address changes for an order
criteria.privacy_legal: personal data requests, data deletion, GDPR or CCPA, legal notices, terms of service

tags.easy: clear-cut: the request and its team are stated plainly
tags.hard: needs care: boundary rules, distractor keywords, mixed topics or an implied need
tags.multi_topic: mentions two areas; the label is the team that must act on the main (explicit) request
tags.misleading_keyword: contains a strong keyword associated with a different team
tags.indirect: the need is implied rather than named
